sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 180.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: yourself. Applies Miracle.
